instructions.bytes_hex: 48 ba ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 00

provenance: Dynamite c90f252f8200765f66c005d6bf4357fda0c0d98e game-over and FOB-result submission bypasses, GPLv3 with Commons Clause 1.0
abi: Shared routine consumes RCX service, DL Boolean, R8D and R9D values, returns Boolean AL. The interface wrapper tail-jumps to it, preserving the original UI return address. Both selected callers ignore the result.
implementation: Detour the shared submission routine; while co-op result suppression is latched, skip only callers returning to 0x888173 or 0x1601554 and return false. Forward all arguments/results for every other caller.
limitations: Static mapping only; no result function was executed and no network request was sent.
This blocks two mapped call sites only, not every online request or future executable version.
The co-op latch lasts through teardown until an explicit next-Mission.Start receipt; interrupted or absent lifecycle delivery remains unverified.
Skipping submission does not establish result-screen completion or UI behavior.
